column1: # The metrics calculated by calculate-metrics.sh, in the order they are displayed.
# This file is read by calculate-metrics.sh, check-pages.sh, update-dashboard-issue.py and update-language-issues.py.
# Columns (separated by a tab, none of them may be empty):
# - id: the name of the result files: check-pages[.<language>]/<id>.txt per language and <id>.txt for the total.
# - languages: "all" or "translations" (the metric doesn't apply to English).
# - source: "check-pages" (the check in check-pages.sh with the same id) or the name of a result of the tldr scripts
#   in calculate-metrics.sh, which is filtered per language.
# - denominator: the total the percentage is calculated on, or "-" for no percentage.
#   It is the sum of a total that check-pages.sh counts per language (check-pages[.<language>]/totals.tsv)
#   over the languages the metric applies to:
#   - pages: the pages.
#   - english-pages: the English pages (the pages every language should have).
#   - pages-need-see-also-mention: the pages whose English page has a "See also" mention recognized by set-see-also.py.
#   - tldr-references: the pages referenced with `tldr <command>`, counted once per page.
#   - see-also-references: the pages mentioned in the first "See also" line, counted once per page.
# - link: how a result is linked in the dashboards: "reference" (link the page mentioned in the result),
#   "edit" (edit the page), "new" (create the page) or "lint" (link the line of the page).
# - label: the description of the metric, used in the output and dashboards.
